title: Can two small windows see farther?
hook: Trace a signal through two local layers.

knows: A network has weights that training nudges to lower a loss.
doesNotKnow: Explain how composed local layers create a larger structural input dependency footprint.

objective: Explain how composed local layers create a larger structural input dependency footprint.
misconception: A3×3 kernel can only ever depend on3×3 input cells.

claims.text: Input5×5; two3×3 all-one cross-correlation kernels, stride1, valid windows, no bias or nonlinearity. Intermediate3×3 and final1×1.
claims.source: src/demos/ai/ai-receptive-field-growth/Demo.tsx#picture#convention; src/demos/ai/ai-receptive-field-growth/model.ts + model.test.mjs finite author implementation reproduction; https://d2l.ai/chapter_convolutional-neural-networks/why-conv.html — Dive into Deep Learning §7.1 locality/composition background, body opened 2026-10-19. Exact dependency union and impulse arithmetic are local indexed derivations.

claims.text: Each first-layer cell structurally reads9 inputs. The final union contains25 input cells, width5. Three such layers give49 cells, width 7.

Exact dependency union and impulse arithmetic are local indexed derivations.

claims.text: Center unit impulse gives nine first-layer ones and final9. Corner unit impulse gives one first-layer one and final1. Zero input gives final0.

claims.text: Structural dependency count is not output value; zero learned weights or cancellation can remove effective influence in other models. Positive all-one weights avoid cancellation here.
